Name: Menu Cycle
Author: AcidicNic
Description:
[size=6][b]Menu Cycle[/b][/size][size=3]
Quickly cycle through varies menus, anywhere, using 1 to 3 hotkeys.[b]

[/b]Name changed. Previously: Special Orders Anywhere[/size][b][size=3]

[/size][size=5]﻿Usage[/size][/b]
[size=3][b]... ⟷ Calendar ⟷ Daily Quests [/b][b]⟷ Special Orders ⟷ Qi's Special Orders ⟷ Journal (Disabled by default) ⟷ ...[/b]

Open/close the first menu in the cycle: [b]P[/b]
Next Menu: [b]][/b]
Previous Menu: [b][[/b]

There are options for a cycle right & left keybind, you can disabled one if you'd like.

If you enable the journal, you can open your journal like normal and cycle left/right from there without using the ActivateKey binding.

[/size][size=3]There are options to access both the Special Orders Board and Qi's Special Orders Board before they are unlocked. Both disabled by default.

[/size][size=5][b]🚨 If you have installed Special Orders Anywhere 🚨[/b][/size][size=3]
Delete the `SpecialOrdersAnywhere` from your `Mods` folder or both mods will be disabled.[/size]


[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/size]
[*][size=3]Extract the zip file into your Mods folder. (You can find the Mods folder using steam by right clicking Stardew Valley, then clicking Properties > Local Files > Browse)[/size]
[/list][size=5][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (Recommended)[/size][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿﻿﻿ from NexusMods.[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Access mod settings from the title screen ([url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/GenericModConfigMenu/docs/screenshot-title.png]via the cog button[/url]﻿﻿﻿) or in-game ([url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/GenericModConfigMenu/docs/screenshot-in-game-options.png]at the bottom of the in-game options menu[/url]﻿﻿)[/size]
[/list][size=5][b]Manual Config[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]A config file called config.json will generate inside of `StardewValley/Mods/MenuCycle/` after [/size][size=3]installing the mod and running the game once[/size][size=3].

[/size][size=3]Open config.json and change `ToggleMonsterList` to your desired key(s).

[size=3]Here's a [url=https://stardewcommunitywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Available_bindings]list of valid keyboard and controller inputs[/url][/size].

[size=3]You can [url=https://stardewcommunitywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Multi-key_bindings]combine keys[/url] to create multi-key bindings[/size].
[size=3]
[size=3][[url=https://github.com/AcidicNic/StardewValleyMods/tree/main?tab=readme-ov-file#menu-cycle-name-changed-previously-special-orders-anywhere]More detailed config instructions on GitHub[/url]][/size][/size][/size]
